values.note: Hillsborough County: $24 a night (up to 8 people with 1 RV/trailer or 2 tents); $18 for an adult 55+, $12 for an adult 65+ who is a Hillsborough County resident (site registered to, and present all nights with, the qualifying person). Park entry $2 per vehicle; camping is extra. Read 2026-10-21.

fees.source: https://hcfl.gov/locations/edward-medard-conservation-park (Camping fees: '$24 per night', '$18 per night for adult 55 or older', '$12 per night for adult 65 or older who is also a resident of Hillsborough County'; Fees: '$2 per vehicle ... Camping and rentals access extra'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://hcfl.gov/locations/edward-medard-conservation-park ('All campsites have a picnic table, electricity, a fire ring, and water'; 'All sites offer 30 amp service, 17 sites also offer 50 amp service'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 43 campsites for RV or tent; sites range from 30 to 60 ft long, most 32-55 ft (county page). One RV/trailer or two tents per site.

sites.source: https://hcfl.gov/locations/edward-medard-conservation-park ('43 campsites that accommodate both RV and tent camping'; 'Sites range from 30 feet in length to 60 feet, with most between 32 - 55 feet'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://hcfl.gov/locations/edward-medard-conservation-park ('Public restrooms with showers and an RV dump station are also available'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://hcfl.gov/locations/edward-medard-conservation-park ('Camping Reservations' / 'Online Camping Reservations' linking to the county's WebTrac site), read 2026-10-21

note: Hillsborough County conservation park on Medard Reservoir (built 1970 for Alafia River flood control). Drive-in RV/tent sites with shell surfacing; loop B is winding with overhead trees. Boat ramp (closed during a reservoir drawdown, county page 2026-10-21). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $24 base (55+/65+ resident discounts), 43 sites, 50-amp max (all 30-amp) with water, showers, dump.
